channel.title: Operation Ouch!
channel.desc: The doctors reveal what comes out of your mouth when you cough, Dr Xand gets a front-row seat at a life-changing operation and there are more intriguing medical mysteries to solve in Ouch & About. Meanwhile, over in accident and emergency, one patient has fallen and banged her head, and another has a toy coin stuck up his nose.
